objective: Complete the current climb while preserving enough health and resources to survive later encounters.
mechanics: This is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. A run alternates between combat, rewards, route choices, events, shops, and rest opportunities. Defeating an encounter is progress, not proof that the run is complete.

During the player's turn, cards provide actions and commonly spend energy. Read the visible cost and card text; character resources, statuses, relics, and upgrades can change legality and results. Do not assume a fixed energy allowance or hand size.

Enemy intent, health, block, and status effects help assess incoming damage and viable targets. Block and health are distinct resources. Read current modifiers before estimating damage or deciding whether an attack is lethal.
Cards move between hand, draw, discard, and exhaust areas as their rules specify. Rewards, relics, potions, and purchases change future options. Unknown card text and hidden draw order stay unknown.
Cooperative play supports simultaneous player actions. If teammates are present, recheck shared targets and resources after their actions; do not assume the board stayed still while deciding.

controls.input: Mouse primary-button click on a currently visible option.
controls.semantics: Menus, rewards, route nodes, and event options may be selectable. A label is a recognition hint; verify the actual target, modal context, and enabled state.

controls.input: Mouse selection followed by a legal target or play area; drag-and-release is a possible alternative that needs local verification.
controls.semantics: Selection is not proof of play. Observe selection or targeting state before the next input, then confirm resolution from card movement or resource changes. Never assume a second click repeats the first.

controls.input: Click the visible End Turn or context-specific confirmation control when offered.
controls.semantics: Ending the turn advances combat; confirming a discard or reward has a different effect. Follow the current prompt and finish any pending selection first.

controls.input: Hover may reveal details; use a visible back or cancel control where available. Keyboard shortcuts and alternate buttons are unverified.
controls.semantics: Inspection can reveal card or status text. Cancellation and navigation do not imply rollback of a played card, purchase, or committed turn.

observation_focus: Current screen and turn ownership; pending selection, targeting, animation, or modal state.
Visible card text, costs, energy, health, block, enemy intents, targets, statuses, and consumables.
Visible route options, reward descriptions, prices, gold, and confirmation prompts when outside combat.
strategy: Prioritize surviving the current encounter while considering later rooms. Compare preventing damage with eliminating a threat; neither attacking nor blocking is always correct.
Consider card order, costs, target validity, and synergy before committing. End the turn when no worthwhile supported play remains, not merely because an End Turn control is visible.
Choose rewards and routes for the current deck and resources. Skipping a reward can be useful when visibly offered. Never invent unseen options.
uncertainties: Early Access rules and controls can change. Sources were reviewed on the date below; this installed build, bindings, mods, and mouse gestures have not been validated live.
Treat control descriptions as hypotheses until the visible interface and input receipts support them. Unsupported hover, drag, or keyboard actions remain unavailable to the executor.
